name: pharmaguard
description: PharmaGuard - web-only, multi-tenant pharmacy expiry, inventory, safety-support and compliance SaaS

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/types && npm run build -w packages/validation && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/types && npm run typecheck -w packages/validation && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
